lines.zh: 我拖着黑袍走过菌毯，爪尖刮地。
lines.en: My black robe drags across the mycelium, claws scraping stone.

lines.zh: 每走十四步，我就停下嗅一次空气。
lines.en: Every fourteen paces I halt and sniff the air once.

lines.zh: 我的脚爪踩过苔石，留下灰色印子。
lines.en: My claws leave grey prints on the mossy cobble.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞穴边缘走，避开所有火光。
lines.en: I keep to the cave's edge, away from every torch.

lines.zh: 走路时我的袖口垂下，遮住烂掉的手。
lines.en: My sleeve hangs low, hiding the hand that rotted away.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在数你还有几格远。
lines.en: I step in jerks, counting how many blocks away you are.

lines.zh: 苔藓从我领口钻出，随呼吸起伏。
lines.en: Moss pushes out of my collar and rises with each breath.

lines.zh: 我绕开水面，湿透的袍子太重了。
lines.en: I walk around water; a soaked robe is far too heavy.

lines.zh: 我用爪背推开门，木屑落了一地。
lines.en: I shove the door with the back of a claw, splinters falling.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的脚步，好不忘掉呼吸。
lines.en: I count my own steps so I do not forget to breathe.

lines.zh: 林子里的菌丝给我让出一条路。
lines.en: The mycelium in the woods parts to let me through.

lines.zh: 我走得比尸壳慢，却从不迷路。
lines.en: Slower than a husk, yet I never lose the way.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在袍角上蹭干净。
lines.en: I wipe my claws clean on the hem of my robe.

lines.zh: 我低头听菌丝在土里生长。
lines.en: I lower my head and listen to mycelium growing in soil.

lines.zh: 十四格，二十四格，我在心里量。
lines.en: Fourteen blocks, twenty-four; I measure them in my head.

lines.zh: 我抬爪对光，看它微微发绿。
lines.en: I raise a claw to the light and watch it turn faintly green.

lines.zh: 袍子里的身体早就空了大半。
lines.en: Most of the body inside this robe has long gone hollow.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一块发霉的面包皮。
lines.en: I chew a strip of mouldy bread crust.

lines.zh: 有东西在墙后走，我没动。
lines.en: Something walks behind the wall; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我数着洞顶滴下的水珠。
lines.en: I count the drops falling from the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经不会说话了。
lines.en: My tongue has forgotten how to shape words.

lines.zh: 我盯着菌毯，它好像也在盯我。
lines.en: I stare at the mycelium; it seems to stare back.

lines.zh: 我把散开的袍带重新打了个结。
lines.en: I retie the loose cord of my robe into a knot.

lines.zh: 我试着抬起左手，它慢了半拍。
lines.en: I lift my left hand; it answers half a beat late.

lines.zh: 远处有铁傀儡的脚步，我屏住气。
lines.en: An iron golem's steps sound far off; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我数完了今天第一百次呼吸。
lines.en: I finish the hundredth breath I have counted today.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽拉低，遮住半张脸。
lines.en: I pull my hood low to hide half my face.

lines.zh: 爪子搭在膝上，我慢慢等。
lines.en: Claws on my knees, I wait slowly.

lines.zh: 土里的孢子飘起来，我没动。
lines.en: Spores rise from the soil, and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 我数着远处有几声脚步。
lines.en: I count how many footsteps there are far off.

lines.zh: 你身上有菌丝的味道，我认得。
lines.en: You carry the smell of mycelium; I know it.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，用烂掉的鼻子对着你。
lines.en: I lift my chin and aim my ruined nose at you.

lines.zh: 十四格，够我伸手够到你了。
lines.en: Fourteen blocks — close enough for me to reach.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛藏在兜帽里，你看不见。
lines.en: My eyes hide under the hood, where you cannot see them.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，正好省我力气。
lines.en: You stand still; that saves me the effort.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，像在称你的重量。
lines.en: I tilt my head, as if weighing how heavy you are.

lines.zh: 你腰上的火把，让我的一只爪发抖。
lines.en: The torch at your belt makes one of my claws tremble.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，下次别再出现。
lines.en: I have your face memorised; do not show it again.

lines.zh: 你手上的剑很亮，我盯着刃口。
lines.en: Your sword is bright; I watch the edge of the blade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张口，里面全是菌丝。
lines.en: I open my mouth slowly; it is full of mycelium.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的爪子跟着挪。
lines.en: You step back; my claws shift forward to match.

lines.zh: 我能听见你的心跳，越来越快。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, and it keeps quickening.

lines.zh: 疼，但痛觉已经钝了。
lines.en: It hurts, but the ache has gone dull.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我半截袖子。
lines.en: You cut away half of my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，又站回来。
lines.en: I take one step back, then return to my place.

lines.zh: 这伤不碍事，菌丝会补上。
lines.en: The wound is nothing; mycelium will fill it in.

lines.zh: 你砍到骨头了，声音很闷。
lines.en: You struck bone; the sound came out muffled.

lines.zh: 我的爪在抖，可我还站着。
lines.en: My claw is shaking, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 好，你比我想的能打。
lines.en: Well then, you fight better than I guessed.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，指缝里渗出绿水。
lines.en: I press the wound; green water seeps between my fingers.

lines.zh: 三十概率的爪，掉了就掉了。
lines.en: A claw that drops one time in three — let it drop.

lines.zh: 你再打一下，我就记住你的名字。
lines.en: Hit me once more and I will remember your name.

lines.zh: 那点腐肉的味道，让我鼻子发痒。
lines.en: That whiff of rotten flesh makes my nose itch.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我的爪子自己动了。
lines.en: You hold out bread; my claws move on their own.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，可我还是跟过去。
lines.en: I do not eat that, and yet I still follow it.

lines.zh: 咽不下去，可我的喉咙在动。
lines.en: I cannot swallow, yet my throat still moves.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我盯了很久。
lines.en: You set it on the ground; I stare for a long while.

lines.zh: 腐肉、骨头、还有发黑的种子。
lines.en: Rotten flesh, bones, and seeds gone black.

lines.zh: 我曾是唤魔者，如今只认得饿。
lines.en: Once an evoker, now I only know hunger.

lines.zh: 你摇一摇手，我往前迈了一步。
lines.en: You shake your hand; I take one step nearer.

lines.zh: 我不该需要它，可我确实想要。
lines.en: I should not need it, but oh, I want it.

lines.zh: 我的手已经伸出去了，收不回来。
lines.en: My hand is already out, and it will not come back.

lines.zh: 别撞我的袍子，它下面没什么了。
lines.en: Do not bump my robe; there is little left underneath.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我肩上的菌丝抖落一层。
lines.en: You knock into me and a layer of moss shakes loose.

lines.zh: 我站得比你稳，不用扶墙。
lines.en: I stand firmer than you, without touching a wall.

lines.zh: 退开，我的爪尖不认人。
lines.en: Back off; my claw tips do not know friend from foe.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的袍角，我被绊了一下。
lines.en: You tread on my hem, and I stumble a step.

lines.zh: 我们的肩膀碰上，你比我热。
lines.en: Our shoulders meet, and you are warmer than I am.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，只因为懒得争。
lines.en: I give half a step, only because I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 碰到我袖口的东西都会染上灰色。
lines.en: Whatever touches my sleeve comes away stained grey.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，把菌毯刮出一道痕。
lines.en: You retreat too fast, scraping a line through the mycelium.

lines.zh: 撞我一次，我就记住你的骨头。
lines.en: Bump me once, and I remember your bones.

lines.zh: 我们不需要相爱，只需要一具新躯体。
lines.en: We do not need love, only another body that still works.

lines.zh: 菌丝在我们之间牵起一条细线。
lines.en: A thin thread of mycelium runs between us.

lines.zh: 两只唤魔者并排站着，像双生枯树。
lines.en: Two evokers stand side by side, like twin dead trees.

lines.zh: 我把我的一半孢子交给你。
lines.en: I hand you half of my spores.

lines.zh: 你会死，然后跟我一样站起来。
lines.en: You will die, and then rise as I did.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈，边走边撒下菌尘。
lines.en: We circle each other, scattering dust as we go.

lines.zh: 我的爪子搭上你的肩，很轻。
lines.en: My claw rests on your shoulder, very lightly.

lines.zh: 等这一夜过去，我们会有很多孩子。
lines.en: When this night ends, we will have many children.

lines.zh: 你的袍子破了，我来替你缝。
lines.en: Your robe is torn; let me stitch it for you.

lines.zh: 我们并排走进黑暗，谁也不回头。
lines.en: We walk into the dark side by side, neither looking back.

lines.zh: 我捡起那根旧木棍，当成魔杖握着。
lines.en: I pick up the old stick and hold it like a wand.

lines.zh: 这枚绿宝石？我早就忘了它的用处。
lines.en: This emerald? I have long forgotten what it is for.

lines.zh: 骨头归我，反正你也不需要。
lines.en: The bone is mine; you have no use for it anyway.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，关节响了一串。
lines.en: I bend down, and my joints crack in a row.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，都该属于菌丝。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我把破布塞进袍子里，留作垫肩。
lines.en: I stuff the torn cloth inside my robe as padding.

lines.zh: 这顶帽子戴着很合，我先收下。
lines.en: This hat fits well; I will keep it for now.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚腐坏的苹果，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a spoiled apple and sniff it once.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我替菌丝收着。
lines.en: Your dropped things — I keep them for the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我捡起石块，掂了掂，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a stone, weigh it, and put it down.

lines.zh: 你在我视线里，这就够了。
lines.en: You are within my sight; that is enough.

lines.zh: 十四格，风从你那边吹过来。
lines.en: Fourteen blocks out, and the wind carries your scent.

lines.zh: 我抬爪对准你，路已经通了。
lines.en: I raise my claw toward you; the path is clear.

lines.zh: 别躲在树后，我看得见轮廓。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the tree; I see your outline.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，从这一刻起。
lines.en: I have chosen you, from this very moment.

lines.zh: 菌丝在土里替我把你的位置指出来。
lines.en: The mycelium in the soil points out where you stand.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌，所以你是目标。
lines.en: You carry no fungus, and so you are the target.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，你脚下的土就动了。
lines.en: I reach out, and the soil under you shifts.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我的爪子等很久了。
lines.en: You cannot run; my claws have waited a long time.

lines.zh: 就你了，别回头，回头也来不及。
lines.en: You will do. Do not look back; it is too late anyway.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起手臂，对着你数格子。
lines.en: I lift my arm slowly and count the blocks to you.

lines.zh: 十四格，再近一点就没意思了。
lines.en: Fourteen blocks; any closer and it is no sport.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your chest, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我的爪就跟着转向。
lines.en: Every time you move, my claw turns to follow.

lines.zh: 我把重量压到前脚，准备拉你。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward, ready to pull you in.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The hand on your sword is shaking; I see it.

lines.zh: 这一爪落下去，你的甲挡不住。
lines.en: When this claw falls, your armour will not hold.

lines.zh: 我等着你先动，那样更省事。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first; that is easier.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听着就高兴。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone ragged, and I enjoy hearing it.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就退到我的范围里。
lines.en: One more step back puts you inside my reach.

lines.zh: 爪子落下，七点疼，你数得清吗？
lines.en: The claw falls — seven points of pain, can you count it?

lines.zh: 我撕开你的袖子，布料比皮软。
lines.en: I tear your sleeve open; cloth gives way easier than skin.

lines.zh: 这一下没打穿，你的甲不错。
lines.en: That one did not go through; your armour is decent.

lines.zh: 我抓你的肩，把你往菌毯上按。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder and press you into the mycelium.

lines.zh: 血混着孢子，落在地上会发芽。
lines.en: Blood mixed with spores; what falls will sprout.

lines.zh: 你挡得及时，可我的爪不止一只。
lines.en: You blocked in time, but I have more than one claw.

lines.zh: 我挠过你的盾面，留下三道沟。
lines.en: I rake across your shield, leaving three furrows.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我正好跟上再来。
lines.en: You fall back two steps; I follow and swing again.

lines.zh: 我这一爪带着腐土的味道。
lines.en: This claw of mine still smells of rotting soil.

lines.zh: 你捂着伤口，菌已经进去了。
lines.en: You clutch the wound; the fungus is already inside.

lines.zh: 我从菌丝里站起来，袍子还是旧的。
lines.en: I rise out of the mycelium, robe still as old as before.

lines.zh: 死的时候我是唤魔者，醒来还是。
lines.en: I died an evoker, and I woke as one still.

lines.zh: 黑暗的洞穴把我吐了出来。
lines.en: The dark cave spits me out onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我的爪先动，然后身体才记起怎么走。
lines.en: My claw moves first; then the body recalls how to walk.

lines.zh: 醒来的第一件事是清点还剩几根爪。
lines.en: Waking, I count how many claws I still have.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，世界全是灰绿。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the world is all grey-green.

lines.zh: 这里的空气太干净，我不习惯。
lines.en: The air here is too clean; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 土地认得我，它的菌丝朝我伸来。
lines.en: The ground knows me; its mycelium reaches toward me.

lines.zh: 我从腐土里爬出，抖落碎屑。
lines.en: I climb out of the rotten soil and shake off the bits.

lines.zh: 我记得死前最后一眼是绿色的。
lines.en: The last thing I saw before dying was green.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫醒的？我要谢谢他。
lines.en: Who woke me? I should thank them for it.

lines.zh: 我站直身子，关节像枯枝一样响。
lines.en: I straighten up, joints cracking like dry branches.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的袍子，比死还难受。
lines.en: Fire eats my robe, worse than dying did.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖歪了一下。
lines.en: On landing, one of my knees turns wrong.

lines.zh: 水里没有菌丝，我不该下去。
lines.en: There is no mycelium in water; I should not have gone.

lines.zh: 炸得我袍子冒烟，我却没散。
lines.en: The blast sets my robe smoking, yet I hold together.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像一根新骨头。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a new bone.

lines.zh: 这点法术，我活着时也用过。
lines.en: I used magic like that myself, back when I lived.

lines.zh: 我早就不用吃饭了，可还是饿。
lines.en: I stopped needing food long ago, yet I still hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，菌丝在我体内炸开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and the mycelium inside me bursts.

lines.zh: 虚空里什么都没有，连菌也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing in the void, not even fungus.
